auth: public (no session required) — see router.go publicPaths

total_alerts.description: COUNT of all alerts in last 30d, partition-aware

open_alerts.description: COUNT of alerts WHERE status='open' in last 30d

ai_success_rate.description: ratio of analyses with non-empty root_cause / total analyses in last 30d; 0 if no analyses

avg_latency_ms.description: AVG(latency_ms) of analyses in last 30d; 0 if no analyses

resources_covered.description: DISTINCT COUNT of (account_alias, region, resource_type, resource_id) in resources table

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 of when the stats were computed

response_503.description: DB unavailable (current behavior, preserved for tests with nil pool)

sql_queries.total_alerts_30d: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
sql_queries.open_alerts_30d: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE status='open' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
sql_queries.ai_success_30d: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE root_cause <> '')::float / COUNT(*) END, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms),0)::int FROM analyses WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
sql_queries.resources_covered: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT account_alias, region, resource_type, resource_id FROM resources) t

notes: All queries use time-window 30d; partition table alerts is RANGE-partitioned by month, so '30 days' filter is index-friendly. The success_rate aggregation uses FILTER (WHERE ...) to avoid two queries.
